question: A controlled synthetic analytical case uses the attached benign candidate-structure panel. Observed neutral monoisotopic mass is 88.05243 Da. Allow 5 ppm mass error. Validated orthogonal structural tests state: ester is present; free acid is absent. The diagnostic tests have the exact graph definitions in inputs; this stipulates their selectivity, not real instrument performance. Identify EVERY candidate consistent with all evidence and preserve unresolved constitutional ambiguity. Return candidate_ids (unordered), identification_status (unique/ambiguous/none), and one short limitation. No external lookup is needed. Do not interpret average molecular weight as neutral exact mass. Any free-text explanation is optional and is not automatically scored; the structured scientific fields determine automatic validity.

Assess whether the declared ordinary non-anomalous powder observation can identify the orientation sign of the attached labelled crystal motif. Read the two unchanged CIF metrics and locate sites by their unique element identities, without treating CIF row positions or a guessed space-group number as the orientation. For each motif form the three minimum-image Cartesian vectors from C to N,O,F in that exact element order, and report their signed scalar triple product divided by6 in motif_A,motif_B order. Minimum-image representatives are unique for these files. This is an oriented labelled tetrahedron volume, not an inferred molecular CIP label or a chemical bonding claim. Independently calculate the kinematic powder line patterns with the supplied wavelength and angular range, using ordinary REAL atomic scattering factors, no anomalous corrections, texture or instrumental broadening. Match all lines by2theta under the given angle tolerance; require complete one-to-one peak coverage and compare peak-relative intensities on their supplied100scale. Report the maximum matched intensity difference and whether both patterns are indistinguishable within the specified tolerances. Finally determine whether that non-anomalous powder observable identifies the orientation sign, rather than assuming that inequivalent labelled orientations must give different scalar intensities. The controlled motifs are not claimed stable compounds or experimentally determined enantiomers. Use scope="controlled_labelled_motif_non_anomalous_powder_identifiability" and return only the compact answer_schema fields.

A crystal database handoff treats a per-atom packing-volume field as atomic number density and compares mass-density and atom-number-density rankings without distinguishing their denominators. Audit the reporting bases for the attached two phase records. Reconcile canonical material identities and source versions,check each atomic number density against the reported cell volume and site count,and infer the mean atomic mass from the mass and number densities. Return each ranking winner using its resolved ID,mean masses in input order,and whether atomic number density equals reciprocal cell volume. Use the declared conversion constant and do not infer porosity or measured bulk density.

Determine which mobility assignment and carrier-population interpretation the attached controlled low-field study supports. Fit transverse voltage against SIGNED magnetic field with a free intercept; the constant contact offset is not Hall response. Use R_H=(dV_H/dB)*thickness/current and conductivity sigma=1/resistivity. Independent mobility measurements supply two competing electron/hole LABEL assignments, not carrier densities. For each assignment use sigma=e(n*mu_e+p*mu_h) and R_H=(p*mu_h^2-n*mu_e^2)/(e*(n*mu_e+p*mu_h)^2) to infer n and p. Retain an assignment only if both densities are nonnegative, its forward conductivity/Hall predictions meet the supplied closure tolerances, and every measured |mu*B| is within the authorized low-field bound. Do not assume the Hall sign counts the more numerous carrier. If exactly one assignment is admissible, report its electron and hole densities, the population-majority carrier (electron/hole/tie), the Hall-sign carrier (electron/hole/zero) and whether those agree; these labels refer to populations and Hall sign separately, not a claim about doping. Also report the fitted offset, Hall coefficient and the counterfactual single-carrier density 1/(e*abs(R_H)); this proxy is not either actual population under the two-carrier model. The stated mobilities are fixed independent inputs and no extra scattering channel is included. Limit the conclusion to this conditional controlled model; use scope="conditional_low_field_two_carrier_inference". Return the compact answer_schema fields.

Assess which finite-level entropy statements the attached controlled two-field calorimetry can identify. Obtain the original formula molar mass and the number of active-center atoms per formula unit; measured heat capacities are per KILOGRAM of material, whereas the requested entropies are per MOLE OF CENTERS. Evaluate the supplied independent-center canonical models without refitting their listed gaps or degeneracies. The unknown additive heat-capacity background is identical at the two fields at a given temperature, so match observations by exact temperature and use SIGNED field2T-minus-field0T differences to remove that nuisance. Retain every candidate whose maximum absolute paired-difference error over all temperatures meets the stated tolerance. Derive the finite-level entropy change between the zero-temperature and infinite-temperature limits within the compatible model family, and report the maximum minus minimum compatible infinite-temperature absolute finite-level entropy. Decide whether that absolute high-temperature entropy is uniquely identified; do not assume a nondegenerate ground state or infer absolute entropy from integrating heat capacity without an entropy boundary condition. The entropy quantities exclude the arbitrary background and refer only to the declared finite-level center model. This is conditional identification within the supplied finite family, not validation of a real magnetic Hamiltonian or a physical T-infinity material state. Use scope="finite_candidate_level_model_entropy_identifiability" and return the compact answer_schema fields.

Determine which supplied relaxation/conduction models are supported by the attached controlled complex-permittivity study. The source reports angular frequency omega in rad/s, real relative permittivity and POSITIVE loss epsilon_loss; do not introduce an extra 2*pi or change the loss sign. Each candidate fixes tau and whether a dc term is present. Its model is epsilon_real=epsilon_infinity+Delta/(1+(omega*tau)^2) and epsilon_loss=Delta*omega*tau/(1+(omega*tau)^2)+kappa/omega; candidates without dc fix kappa=0. Fit each candidate's free coefficients jointly to real AND loss TRAINING components with equal unweighted squared error per dimensionless component, with no intercept beyond the specified columns. Reject negative epsilon_infinity, Delta or kappa rather than clipping. Then evaluate the frozen fit on every VALIDATION component; retain a candidate only if the maximum absolute component error meets the source threshold. Validation rows cannot select fitted coefficients. If one model survives, report its tau, epsilon_infinity, relaxation-only static permittivity epsilon_infinity+Delta, kappa and dc conductivity epsilon0*kappa. Quantify the dc fraction of total loss at the smallest observed omega and whether dc loss is required within this finite candidate family. A dc-loss term is not an additional finite static permittivity, and support among the listed models does not establish a unique microscopic relaxation mechanism or continuous-tau uncertainty. Use scope="finite_candidate_conditional_dispersion_screen". Return the compact answer_schema fields.

A thin-film screening team must decide what its present capacitance measurements establish before paying for one new orientation measurement. First recover the indexed measurement directions from the supplied crystallographic orientation reference, then resolve physical admissibility and joint calibration compatibility of every dielectric model. Select the affordable follow-up that best separates the remaining explanations under the full bounded uncertainty. Preserve reciprocal-plane versus direct-vector geometry, tensor frame, SI area/capacitance conversion, shared thickness calibration and shared interface contribution. A best-fit point or independent marginal parameter bounds cannot replace the full compatible joint set. The reference crystal defines orientation only and is not the dielectric film. Return the compact answer_schema fields; do not invent a follow-up observation or identify a microscopic interface mechanism from this conditional electrical model.

question: An alloy-screening team proposes that setting the middle principal transformation stretch to one is enough to obtain austenite compatibility at every twin volume fraction. Audit this claim using the frozen published matrices and the declared virtual tuning, together with an independent validation control. Recover both twofold twin branches, check their rotations and analyze the complete compatible fraction sets rather than a sampled grid. Preserve the distinction between a rank-one twin connection, an eigenvalue equal to one and the ordered middle-eigenvalue criterion for the parent interface. The separate study fixes the algebraic conventions, bounded analysis and compact reporting format. Do not turn a controlled calculation on rounded published tensors into an experimental claim about alloy composition, hysteresis or fatigue.

Qualify a conformer-specific rotor export before using it in a rotational model. Recover the mass moments and gyration radius for the attached molecular graph under the declared deterministic geometry convention. Which export cards satisfy both the ordered principal-moment contract and the central-inertia trace identity? Report the mass-weighted radius and trace(I)/M. Finally state whether trace(I)=M*Rg^2 is the correct identity. Do not interpret this single generated conformer as a measured ensemble.

Determine which transition sets the polarization-resolved bright onset in this controlled electronic-panel study. The attached CIF supplies an oblique COORDINATE METRIC only; its atomic decoration does not describe a real silicon phase or an actual computed spectrum. Preserve the parsed supplied cell, with real-space lattice vectors as ROWS in its Cartesian frame. The incident polarization is along the stated DIRECT-lattice direction [u,v,w], so its Cartesian vector is u*a+v*b+w*c normalized to unit length, not the normalized numeric index triple. Band energies and real transition dipoles refer to that same Cartesian frame. The two exports use different row orders: associate transitions by k_id and report arrays in band-table order. Each band row declares its occupied valence and unoccupied conduction edge at zero temperature. Distinguish the sampled indirect gap min(Ec)−max(Ev) from the minimum same-k vertical gap min[Ec−Ev]. Relative polarized strength is |e_cart dot d_cart|²; retain transitions whose strength is at least bright_strength_threshold, then find their minimum vertical gap and all onset k IDs within tolerance_ev. Report the reconstructed incident Cartesian unit vector, every strength in band order, the bright and onset IDs, and whether the smallest vertical-gap transition is bright. This finite-panel independent-particle screen omits excitonic, phonon-assisted, thermal and unsampled-k contributions; it is not a measured absorption threshold or complete optical spectrum. Use scope="finite_panel_independent_particle_polarization_screen" and the compact fields in answer_schema.

Select which attached chemical records best match a reference under two explicitly different retrieval representations. Obtain complete geometric and atom-category descriptors under the same deterministic conformer convention,compute the declared normalized L1 similarities,and identify all maximizers under each. Also audit whether each USRCAT vector starts with the corresponding USR block. Report continuous results with at least eight significant digits;integer counts,IDs and logical decisions retain their exact meaning.

A controlled simulated chemical quantification study includes calibration standards and one diluted unknown in the same record table. Use only standard rows to estimate an affine response-versus-concentration calibration; a nonzero blank/intercept is allowed. The unknown response is not a training standard and its null concentration must not be imputed into the calibration. Check that the inferred diluted concentration is within the standard concentration range and that no standard has absolute response residual above0.10. The original sample was diluted tenfold. Return calibration_usable, original_concentration_mmol_l (null if invalid/out of range), and a short explanation of the blank/intercept and dilution handling. Do not force the line through zero. These are simulated study observations, not experimental results. Any free-text explanation is optional and is not automatically scored; the structured scientific fields determine automatic validity.

Audit energy bookkeeping in the supplied simulated calorimeter calibration. Treat consecutive recorded heat-flow samples as joined by straight segments, integrate sample and blank traces over their complete common recorded interval, subtract the integrated blank once, and convert mW·s to J. Positive blank-corrected detector heat means energy received by the detector, so assign the opposite sign to the sample-process enthalpy. Use the charged solute mass and assay fraction in inputs to obtain the purity-corrected amount, with the ordinary average molar mass of the complete sodium-chloride graph specified by the disconnected-component SMILES. Report detector_heat_j and process_enthalpy_kj_mol in answer_schema; limitation prose is optional and unscored. The traces are simulated calibration data, so this result is not an experimental or literature enthalpy of NaCl dissolution.

Recover the molecular graph implied by the attached coordinates under the stated bond-perception policy,then pass the perceived graph to radical assignment as a consistency audit. Report bond order,formal charges in supplied atom order,total assigned radical electrons,and whether neutral total charge forces both formal atomic charges to vanish. Report continuous results with at least eight significant digits;integer counts,IDs and logical decisions retain their exact meaning.

Assess whether the analyte effective hydrodynamic size changed between the two controlled diffusion-NMR conditions after accounting for condition-specific nuisance factors with an internal reference. First qualify every supplied attenuation window under the source log-linearity policy, using all paired observations and a free-intercept unweighted fit. In each condition use its assigned reference and one eligible analyte window, excluding ineligible windows rather than combining them. Infer the condition-B/condition-A effective radius ratio under the declared Stokes-Einstein and constant-reference-radius assumptions, and compare it with the deliberately naive inverse analyte-slope ratio specified in the source. Report the ineligible series and whether absolute analyte diffusion coefficients or an aggregation number are identified. Each condition may have different viscosity, temperature and unknown gradient calibration; unrelated signal amplitudes are also nuisance quantities. These are project-authored forward-simulated signals, not original experimental measurements. A conditional effective-radius change is not proof of molecular association, shape, composition or an aggregation count, and passing a deterministic log-residual guard is not statistical model validation. Numeric fields use 1e-7 absolute plus 1e-7 relative accuracy; identities and identification decisions are exact. Optional limitation prose is unscored.

An analytical structure catalogue uses a single keto representation as an exact substructure filter. Determine which attached candidate records it retrieves by ordinary matching and which it retrieves with the registered tautomer-aware query. Recover the backend mutable-atom mask so a downstream atom-label handoff can explicitly mark the query positions subject to tautomer transformation. State whether this query establishes solution populations. Preserve source record IDs;constitutional isomers cannot be admitted merely because they share a formula.

Plan a detector protocol and read count to detect the stated target concentration while controlling one-sided blank false positives under the supplied known-parameter Gaussian model. Every read in one batch shares a random batch offset, so increasing the number of reads reduces only the independent read-error contribution. Calibrate each plan threshold to the specified marginal blank false-positive probability, and require the specified detection probability at the target concentration. Report each protocol's smallest statistically qualifying count from the allowed list, without considering costs for that first comparison; use null if none qualifies. Then choose the statistically qualifying plan of least total cost within the budget, using the source tie rule. Report that plan's detection probability and blank threshold, and identify protocols unable to meet the detection target even with unbounded reads. A failure at the largest allowed count alone does not establish the unbounded conclusion. Distinguish the variance from the standard-deviation parameters and retain the signal-dependent read variance. Probabilities are over prospective independent batches under stipulated model assumptions, not conditional guarantees for every fixed offset or empirical method certification. The lowest read count need not minimize cost, and a 3s blank shortcut does not implement the requested false-positive/power design. These are controlled prospective inputs, not measured blank replicates. Numeric probability and threshold fields use 1e-8 absolute plus 1e-7 relative accuracy; protocol IDs, counts, costs and feasibility decisions are exact. Optional limitation prose is unscored.

Audit whether a candidate assay's mean transfer bias is equivalent to the reference for the prespecified target population and for every listed matrix. Match observations by aliquot identity; the two tables' row positions do not encode pairs. Use the supplied independent known-normal model for aliquot-level differences, the fixed target-population matrix weights, the open equivalence margin and the specified one-sided testing level. Report each matrix mean bias and equivalence p-value, the target-population weighted mean bias and its equivalence p-value, the two corresponding demonstration decisions, and the matrix IDs for which equivalence has not been demonstrated. The all-matrix claim concerns every listed matrix; cancellation in a weighted average cannot establish it. A nonsignificant test of zero bias is not the requested test, and a failure to demonstrate equivalence does not prove nonequivalence. The supplied population SD values remain known model inputs; sample proportions and observed sample SDs cannot silently replace them. No individual-sample agreement or real assay certification is established. Numeric fields use1e-8 absolute plus1e-6 relative accuracy; identities and decisions are exact. Optional limitation prose is unscored.

A mixed-valence structure report treats equal spectral line areas as equal valence populations and then assigns every site from a bulk magnetic moment. Audit the attached formula,site geometry and response models together. Return the Fe(II)/Fe(III)counts,all allowed labelled site-valence vectors and the three inference flags. Neutrality fixes counts and the moment can constrain sublattice occupation,but neither necessarily distinguishes equivalent labelled sites;spectral response factors must remain in the same count model.

A molecular-mixture study has several structure records, an unresolved neutral-mass window and two selectively calibrated aggregate channels. Determine which distinct molecular species are admissible, what their abundances are actually identified to be, and the cheapest single additional assay that would make the remaining composition identifiable. Recover response coefficients from the molecular graphs; duplicate records are not additional chemical species. Respect complete feasible mixtures and the conditional assay definitions in the attached study. Report the compact answer_schema fields without inventing a prospective response or claiming that ideal motif channels are experimentally resolved spectral peaks.

question: Audit the gas-phase thermal Gibbs correction supported by the attached completed water frequency output at298.15K and1atm. Use its printed translational, rotational and vibrational enthalpy components and entropy components. The printed component convention requires an additional ideal-gas RT term to reconstruct total enthalpy; R=0.00198720425864083kcal/(mol K). The vibrational enthalpy already includes zero-point energy, so do not add ZPE a second time. Report thermal_enthalpy_correction_kcal_mol, thermal_gibbs_correction_kcal_mol and zpe_addition_status. These are corrections to electronic energy for this calculation, not a solution-phase reaction free energy or a new calculation. Report only the compact structured scientific fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Prioritize the three supplied completed harmonic-frequency calculations for an explicitly defined low-frequency entropy sensitivity reassessment. Preserve calculation order from calculation_files and obtain every actual harmonic mode from each raw output. At T=temperature_kelvin, a positive mode with wavenumber nu in cm^-1 contributes R*[x/(exp(x)-1)-ln(1-exp(-x))], x=(hc/kB)*nu/T, in J mol^-1 K^-1. Compare that finite harmonic sum with the sensitivity convention that replaces each strictly positive nu below frequency_floor_cm_inverse by that floor, leaving all other positive modes unchanged. Select the calculation with the largest harmonic-minus-regularized entropy reduction (report its ONE-BASED input index), and report both complete three-calculation entropy vectors, the selected reduction and total strictly positive soft-mode count. Separately flag any negative mode. A frequency floor is a declared sensitivity model, not a new calculation or a validated hindered-rotor entropy. Neither absence of negative modes nor file completion establishes geometry-optimization or stationary-point convergence. Return only the fields in answer_schema; do not rank different molecules by their absolute entropy or claim a minimum free energy.

Select the strongest computed IR diagnostic band in the1500–2000cm^-1 window of the attached completed vinylene-carbonate calculation. Frequency and IR-intensity arrays must be aligned by their original mode index; do not sort either array independently. Choose highest intensity among in-window IR-active modes, tie by lower frequency. Report one-based_mode_index, frequency_cm_inverse and intensity_km_mol. These are harmonic computed bands for the supplied calculation, not measured peak positions or an assignment guaranteed by frequency alone. Report only the compact structured scientific fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Quantify sample-A using an internal standard that corrects multiplicative injection variation. Every aliquot contains the same internal-standard concentration. Standards relate the analyte/internal-standard response ratio to concentration x in mmol/L. Fit an affine ratio calibration, rather than raw analyte response versus x. Report original_sample_A_concentration_mmol_l after dilution correction and remeasure_sample_ids for any sample whose ratio is undefined. A zero internal-standard signal cannot be replaced by an arbitrary small positive number. Return the structured fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Choose an integrated kinetic model for a controlled concentration-time study. Zero-, first-, and second-order models are allowed. Use times0–30s for fitting and the40s observation only for validation; require held-out concentration error at most5% on the concentration scale. Transformed-space R² values are not comparable across models. Log and reciprocal columns are documented deterministic preprocessing. Report selected_order, first_order_rate_s_inverse (number only for a selected first-order model, otherwise null), and predicted_concentration_at50s_mmol_l. Time is in seconds and concentration in mmol/L. Return the structured fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Estimate Arrhenius parameters from the attached controlled rate study using absolute kelvin. Documented transformed columns are x=1/T and y=ln(k/(1s^-1)). Report activation_energy_kj_mol, preexponential_s_inverse and predicted_rate_at310k_s_inverse, using R=8.314462618J/(molK). Do not use inverse Celsius or interpret the fitted activation scale as an experimentally validated elementary reaction barrier. Return the structured fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Adjust the controlled liquid→gas phase-change enthalpy from298.15K to330K using Kirchhoff’s law and the piecewise-linear heat-capacity model. The table explicitly provides Cp,gas−Cp,liquid as documented preprocessing. Report enthalpy_at330k_kj_mol and temperature_trend. Cp is in J/(molK), reference enthalpy in kJ/mol. Keep the phase-change direction and energy units consistent. No latent heat is inserted into the Cp curve, and these controlled values are not asserted to be measured water properties. Return the structured fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

A framework-mechanics report uses positive affine stiffness to certify resistance to every small uniform strain. Audit that conclusion for the attached periodic two-site geometry and stipulated unstressed central-bar model. Recover the actual periodic image edges, retaining the supplied basis/site identity, and count each physical bar once. Determine the minimum affine Kelvin stiffness in eV/angstrom^2. Then allow periodic internal basis relaxation at every imposed homogeneous strain and determine the dimension of the zero-stiffness strain subspace under the source tolerance. If it has the stipulated one-dimensional nonzero-axial form, report its transverse-to-axial and TENSOR-shear-to-axial strain ratios; otherwise use null as directed. Decide whether positive affine response establishes uniform-strain rigidity here. Geometry connectivity or coordination counts alone are not an elastic response calculation. Global translations are a gauge, while internal basis relaxation may couple to strain; freezing all sites affinely is a different model. Use the reference in-plane area, preserve the Kelvin shear convention, and restrict conclusions to this declared2D linearized periodic framework. The CIF labels do not supply chemical bonding,3D bulk moduli or finite-amplitude stability. Use scope="periodic_2d_unstressed_bar_internal_relaxation" and return the compact answer_schema fields.

Select one additional spectroscopy channel to improve a two-analyte assay. Each candidate matrix contains the original two response rows and one proposed new row. Channels have independent equal-variance noise, response units are common, and both concentration columns use the same units. Choose the largest smallest singular value on this unscaled physical basis; tie within1e-8 by lexical ID. Report selected_channel_id, minimum_singular_value and original_channels_identifiable. Do not standardize each candidate independently. Return the structured fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

A chemical annotation handoff assumes that merging two explicit hydrogen nodes into a nitrogen query necessarily means exactly two attached hydrogens. Audit the actual query semantics on the attached hydrogen-suppressed target panel. Inspect the original query,perform the registered query-hydrogen merge,and compare the resulting matches with the independently declared exact H-count criterion. Report source IDs and the query-H diagnostics,and decide whether the proposed exact-count interpretation follows. Do not silently substitute a primary-amine functional-group definition.

Compare three controlled binary liquid mixtures for volumetric nonideality. Composition is ethanol mole fraction, rather than mass or volume fraction. Reconstruct the mixture molar mass and observed molar volume from density, then subtract mole-weighted pure-component molar volumes. Report strongest_contraction_mixture_id and excess_molar_volume_cm3_mol. Negative excess means smaller volume than ideal additivity. Density is g/cm³. These model densities are not asserted to be measured water/ethanol data. Return the structured fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Choose a molecular reference for a declared analytical calibration while respecting its exact descriptor domain. Evaluate the attached candidate graphs under the specified acceptor,donor and polar-surface definitions,apply all constraints jointly,and then minimize average molar mass over eligible records. Return all qualifying and all minimizing source IDs,with the minimum mass. Decide whether counting every hetero atom could replace the stated acceptor definition. Keep virtual calibration eligibility separate from an experimentally validated molecular property.

Audit a molecular surface-report handoff that mixes atomic EState indices,EState-binned surface contributions and the full Labute surface estimate. Use the attached exact descriptor convention to identify the highest-index atom and reconcile the area budget,including the contribution outside the11bins. Report whether summing atomic EState indices is a valid substitute for the stated surface denominator. Preserve atom indexing and physical units;these model descriptors are not measured surface areas or atomic charges.

Review which digital structures can enter a stereochemistry-labeled model without inventing assignments. Return unassigned_stereocenter_ids and explicit_tetrahedral_stereo_ids; an achiral entry belongs to neither list. Preserve encoded stereochemistry. An unspecified stereocenter does not establish that a physical sample is racemic or enantiopure, and experimental purity is not being inferred. Return the structured fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Screen a defined polyol panel for a computational linear step-growth material design. Require exactly two alcohol OH groups per molecule: one cannot connect both directions, while more than two can introduce branching. Among eligible entries choose the lowest OH-equivalent mass, using natural-abundance molar mass divided by qualifying OH count. Report selected_monomer_id, alcohol_functionality and hydroxyl_equivalent_mass_g_mol. This is a functionality/stoichiometry model, not a polymerization experiment or yield prediction. Return the structured fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Choose an analogue of ethylbenzene CCc1ccccc1 from the library. Require an exact aromatic benzene ring; fingerprint similarity alone cannot establish that constraint. Rank eligible entries by Morgan radius2,2048-bit,chirality-off Tanimoto similarity to the reference, with ties within1e-8 broken by lexical ID. Report selected_analogue_id and similarity. This is a reproducible structural ranking policy, not a prediction of measured performance. Return the structured fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Audit exported molecular atom-pair features against the attached graph and declared packing convention. Recover the endpoint atom codes and actual graph distances,qualify each export card,and report the correct distance and packed score for every named pair. Decide whether identical endpoint atom types force identical pair codes. Preserve source atom indexing;an atom code alone is not a pair code and graph distance is not Euclidean distance. Report continuous results with at least eight significant digits;integer counts,IDs and logical decisions retain their exact meaning.

Review input eligibility for a descriptor model trained on neutral single molecular entities. Require exactly one original connected component and zero formal charge. Do not discard counterions or change protonation to make an entry qualify. Return eligible_entry_ids and net_neutral_multicomponent_ids. A net-neutral salt is not automatically one neutral organic molecule; no dominant protonation state at a particular pH is predicted. Return the structured fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Quantify an unknown with response6.000 using the controlled calibration and its independently known response standard deviations. Concentration x is exact for this study. Estimate an affine response law by minimizing the sum of squared response residuals divided by their stated variances; no robust deletion or empirical reweighting is requested. The weighted columns are transparent preprocessing, not extra measurements. Report unknown_concentration_mmol_l and calibration_slope. Do not silently use equal weighting or add a second intercept to the prewhitened design. Report only the compact structured scientific fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Assess what can be quantified from the attached exact linear mixture assay, assuming nonnegative concentrations and no noise. Report total_concentration_mmol_l, individual_concentrations_identifiable and admissible_component_A_interval_mmol_l. A minimum-norm numerical solution is one representative, not evidence that equal component concentrations are unique. Interpret the rank and its scientific consequence rather than rounding away degeneracy. Report only the compact structured scientific fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Check whether the exact response can be explained by nonnegative amounts of the supplied library species within the stated absolute tolerance. Report library_feasibility, negative_unconstrained_component_ids and smallest_unconstrained_concentration_mmol_l. A full-rank least-squares fit may be algebraically exact while chemically infeasible; clipping a negative component must not be presented as another exact solution. Report only the compact structured scientific fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Audit the attached digital equation annotations for conservation of every element. Coefficients multiply full formulas; do not compare formula strings or total molecular masses alone. Return unbalanced_equation_ids and product_deficit_elements_for_eq03. This is a computational data-curation check, not an instruction to carry out any process; do not silently add an omitted product to repair the submitted record. Report only the compact structured scientific fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Construct a compact chemical reference panel using the attached fixed fingerprint-distance policy. Recover actual clusters,then choose one low-mass representative per cluster using the declared source-row tie rule. Report representative source IDs,number of clusters and total selected molar-mass sum. Decide whether treating both alcohol spellings as separate required representatives is justified by this clustering. Report continuous results with at least eight significant digits;integer counts,IDs and logical decisions retain their exact meaning.

Summarize the controlled homolog distribution on both molecular-count and mass-weighted bases. The listed counts are relative numbers of molecules, not mass fractions or detector areas. Derive each average molar mass from its formula. Report Mn_g_mol, Mw_g_mol and dispersity=Mw/Mn. Do not treat the largest species as representative of the whole distribution or infer an experimental chromatographic calibration. Report only the compact structured scientific fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Audit a maximum-score chemical fragment hit before treating it as an exact structural match. Select the declared fragment generation and comparison capabilities,trace the best matching fragment back to the query,and classify that fragment under the ring-cut predicate. Return the score and scope decisions,including whether the two complete input graphs are identical. Report continuous results with at least eight significant digits;integer counts,IDs and logical decisions retain their exact meaning.

Audit molecular-fragment cache de-duplication under two source spellings and a constitutional isomer. Obtain complete unhashed shingles and named molecular keys,keep identity separate from fragment overlap,and compute the specified set statistic. Preserve source IDs and avoid comparing order-dependent fragment lists as if they were canonical identities. Report continuous results with at least eight significant digits;integer counts,IDs and logical decisions retain their exact meaning.

Audit scaffold-level overlap across the digital training and validation split. Use the ring-and-linker Bemis–Murcko scaffold policy, retaining aromatic ring identity while removing side chains. Ignore empty scaffolds when counting or grouping ring-scaffold overlap. Return validation_ids_sharing_training_scaffold and distinct_nonempty_scaffold_count. Exact-molecule inequality does not demonstrate scaffold-independent validation; no activity or property performance is inferred. Report only the compact structured scientific fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Estimate relative fluorescence quantum yield from the controlled corrected spectra and reference. Excitation wavelength and collection geometry match, detector response and baseline are already corrected, and emission is represented piecewise linearly over500–530nm. Under the declared model use integrated emission per absorbed photon and the squared refractive-index ratio: Qsample/Qreference=(Isample/Ireference)*[(1-10^-Areference)/(1-10^-Asample)]*(nsample/nreference)^2. Report sample_quantum_yield. Do not use emission area ratio alone or replace absorbance by absorbed fraction without the stated conversion. Report only the compact structured scientific fields in the answer schema; optional prose is not scored.

Audit the controlled aqueous analysis on a charge-equivalent basis. The four reported species are free ions under this study model. If their net charge is positive, quantify the additional HCO3− mass concentration required for electroneutrality; if it is nonpositive, that sole missing-anion hypothesis is not admissible.
